no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Citius Oncology is a single-asset commercial-stage company. LYMPHIR (denileukin diftitox-cxdl) was FDA-approved August 7, 2024 for relapsed/refractory CTCL and launched in December 2025; the pivotal Phase 3 (E7777-G000-302) is COMPLETED. The two ongoing P1/P2 trials of LYMPHIR (NCT04855253 at U Minnesota; NCT05200559 at U Pittsburgh with pembrolizumab) are investigator-initiated with university lead sponsors, not Citius-sponsored — excluded under scope rules.
